frozen_rule.metric: Another individual who is an active head of state of a UN member state at capture, physically taken into custody/detained so not free to leave; U.S. government personnel must directly participate on the ground in the capture. Support/intelligence/logistics/advisory alone do not qualify; US government contractors qualify only when confirmed acting under US direction.

primary_context.event: Official White House Jan 4, 2026 summary of Secretary of State Marco Rubio’s comments on Operation Absolute Resolve and Nicolás Maduro. The page says Maduro was apprehended; Rubio is quoted saying US forces were on the ground for about two hours when they went to capture Maduro. In the same page Rubio states Maduro “was not the head of state.”

interpretive_limit: This capsule records the official US administration’s description only. It does not adjudicate whether Maduro met the frozen active-head-of-state condition at capture, whether the operation qualifies as a prior “world leader” capture under the market, or whether any other event qualifies. No exhaustive event scan was performed; no conclusion about future captures.
source_limit: One official White House source captured; no independent court/UN status source was sought in this bounded pass.
